messages:
prod-monitoring-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: canary 'inference-svc-canary' 5xx rate 27% (2m). 3/5 canary pods CrashLoopBackOff. Rolling deploy started ~1m ago.
oncall-derek: I'm on it — pulling pod status and logs now.
sre-amber: stepping in, tagging in. Which node are the canaries on?
oncall-derek: canary-0/canary-1 on gke-prod-eu-a, canary-2 on gke-prod-eu-b. Getting logs from canary-0: `kubectl -n prod logs inference-canary-0`
eng-sam: I pushed the canary ~2m ago. The only change was probe path (healthz -> /ready) + small model path env change behind a feature flag.
sre-amber: logs show repeated "Liveness probe failed: HTTP probe failed with statuscode: 500" and then OOM/killed on restart cycles.
eng-sam: hmm — the new readiness handler expects MODEL_PATH env var; if missing it returns 500 during bootstrap. I thought feature flag set that for canary only.
platform-nora: HPA is also scaling crazy — saw minReplicas=10 in the canary HPA object (should be 2). Possibly wrong manifest applied during cutover. Nodes are pressure-scheduling other pods evicted.
oncall-derek: trying to cordon one node to stop further evictions, but drain is failing: `error: node(s) have non-evictable pods (local storage / PDB)`
sre-amber: PDB for stateful exporters blocking eviction. We should avoid full node drains for now.
eng-sam: can we flip the feature flag kill-switch to stop new probe logic? That will make containers use old probe path and should avoid 500s.
pm-luis: approved. Flip it. Customer impact looks limited to EU canaries.
deploy-bot: Feature flag toggled: `infra.canary_new_probe = false` via LaunchDarkly by pm-luis.
oncall-derek: observed new pods being created — they start with previous behavior. Watching logs.
prod-monitoring-bot: :hourglass_flowing_sand: 5xx rate dropped to 8% (1m) — continuing to trend down.
sre-amber: also patching HPA to safe min while we stabilize: `kubectl -n prod patch hpa inference --type merge -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":2}}'`
platform-nora: agree — hold off on drain/cordon changes that require evictions. We'll handle PDBs separately.
ops-bot: Customer impact summary: EU regions saw ~12% elevated errors for ~7 minutes during rollout. No traffic loss for US/APAC. Ticket INC-2026-455 created and linked.
eng-sam: opening PR to fix probe path and add smoke test to catch MODEL_PATH missing. Will revert any manifest changes that set minReplicas incorrectly.
oncall-derek: monitoring shows 5xx back to baseline 1.1% over 5m. CrashLoopBackOff count = 0.
prod-monitoring-bot: :white_check_mark: ALERT RESOLVED: canary 'inference-svc-canary' 5xx rate returned to baseline.
oncall-derek: marking incident mitigated. Follow-ups: eng-sam to submit RCA + revert PR; platform-nora to audit HPA manifests for unintended overrides; oncall handoff to sre-amber for next 60m.
sre-amber: acknowledged, will continue 60m watch and validate no regressions.
oncall-derek: closing thread — will draft short postmortem. :thumbsup:
